questions: Who owns the placement replay, placement failure, project-lock allowance, binary-store preservation and state-folder preservation required by the expanded INV-18 test, given that `source_folder` must not own writes or whether a photo was placed?
Who owns the placement, replay, locking, and durable-write parts of INV-18 that are assigned to `source_folder` even though those mechanisms are owned by `photo_delivery` and `delivery_store`?
How can `source_folder` own INV-18 when satisfying and verifying it requires A3 replay and failure rules, project-lock behavior, and binary/state-store writes that it neither knows nor may own?

Who owns the parts of the expanded INV-18 that decide placement failure and constrain writes, given that `source_folder` must not own any write or whether a photo was placed, while `photo_delivery` owns per-photo failure and the checks and writes inside the lock?
